content: This approval signaled broader financial adjustments amid the ongoing challenges within the energy sector, directly contributing to mounting uncertainty for businesses that are heavily reliant on stable and cost-effective energy supplies. The concerns over escalating operational costs are further amplified by the noticeably slow pace of national grid modernization efforts, which leaves commercial entities vulnerable to both financial strain and operational disruptions. Consequently, this environment acts as a powerful demand signal for the solar and electrical installation industry, as commercial and industrial sectors aggressively pursue off-grid or grid-tied solar solutions to hedge against future tariff volatility and secure operational continuity.
